About Bitget🔹
## On the exchange page
Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 150 million users with access to millions of crypto tokens, tokenized stocks, ETFs, and other real-world assets.
The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI-powered trading tools, interoperability across markets, and broader access to real-world assets.
Largest crypto copy trading platform
150 million
Registered users worldwide
20+ billion USDT
Daily trading volume
Our story
Bitget was founded on the steadfast belief in being among the final 10% who stay committed, even in the face of adversity.
With a background in traditional finance, Bitget’s founding team discovered blockchain technology in 2015, but it was viewed as "tulip mania" by the industry back then. In 2018, we became intrigued by cryptocurrency after studying the Bitcoin whitepaper and Ethereum ecosystem. We believed that cryptocurrency would play an important role in the future and even benefit the unbanked groups. However, the market crash chased away most speculators and less than 10% of the people chose to stick to their convictions and rebuild. Bitget was then officially founded in the same year.
Born in a bear market, Bitget insists on putting users first, focusing on product innovation, and advocating long-term development with the spirit of earnestness. Our goal is to empower more people to embrace crypto and make smarter trades—one step at a time.
Vision
We believe in a more equitable future world driven by crypto evolution.
Mission
We empower the future of finance by ensuring secure, efficient and smart digital transactions.
Our values
Users first
We genuinely care about the voice of each and every user.
Integrity and honesty
We prioritize earning trust by consistently adhering to responsible and ethical standards.
Open communication
We communicate transparently and promptly, sharing all the good, the bad, and the ugly.
Deliver results
Change won't happen itself. We take deliberate actions to make it happen.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Dual Investment Challenge Phase 7: Up to $4,000

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Gate rolls out the Dual Investment Position Challenge. During the event, users who subscribe to and hold Dual Investment products will receive corresponding rewards of up to $4,000.
## Event Period: November 25, 2026, 08:00 – December 02, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Newbie Reward
Users who have never purchased Dual Investment products before the event can receive a $500 trial fund by subscribing ≥$100 during the event period.
## Holding Rewards
During the event period, users who reach the following tiers of daily average holding amount will receive the corresponding rewards. Rewards cannot be stacked and will be distributed based on the highest tier achieved.
Holding Amount | Reward (Trial Funds)
≥ 100 USDT | $100
≥ 1,000 USDT | $500
≥ 10,000 USDT | $1,500
≥ 100,000 USDT | $3,500
## Notes
- This event is only available to users who have completed identity verification. Each verified user can only participate with one main account; subaccounts are not considered independent for participation.
- Daily holding snapshots are taken at 08:00 (UTC), with the calendar day determined according to the UTC time zone.
- The Calculation Formula of Daily Average Holding = Sum of All Daily Snapshot Amounts During the Event Period / Total Days of the Event.
- To protect all participants and ensure fairness, any form of cheating is strictly prohibited. Users found violating the rules will be immediately disqualified .
- During the event, investments in all coins and both directions of Dual Investment products will count toward the subscription amount. For Dual Investment "Sell High" products, the subscription amount will be converted to USDT based on the coin price at the time of investment.
- Rewards will be issued as Dual Investment trial fund vouchers within 14 working days after the event ends. Each voucher is valid for 7 days and can be viewed and used in [Vouchers]. The maximum total reward per user is 4,000 USDT in Dual Investment Trial Funds.
- Trial funds can only be used for Dual Investment and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.
- Disclaimer: Users in the UK and other restricted regions are not eligible for this event/competition. Please refer to the User Agreement for more details about the restricted regions.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation for this event.

Venue: Hibt
Headline: Hibt Launches "Trade PEARL – Share a 300 PEARL Reward Pool" Campaign

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear Hibtizens,
To thank our users for their continued support, Hibt is launching the "Trade PEARL – Share a 300 PEARL Reward Pool" campaign. Details are as follows:
## 1. Event Period
2026-11-25 04:00 – 2026-11-27 16:00 (UTC)
## 2. Activity Rules
## (1) Trade to Earn
During the event, users who trade the PEARL/USDT trading pair on Hibt with a cumulative trading volume (buy + sell, calculated in USDT) of ≧ 300 USDT will receive:
3 USDT contract profit bonus + 1 PEARL token, this reward is only available to the first 100 users who meet the trading volume requirement.
## (2) Trading Volume Ranking Bonus
Users who meet the minimum trading volume requirements and rank among the Top 10 by trading volume will share an additional 200 PEARL reward pool.
Rank | Reward | Minimum Trading Volume
1st | 40 PEARL | ≧ 50,000 USDT
2nd–5th | 25 PEARL each | ≧ 40,000 USDT
6th–10th | 12 PEARL each | ≧ 20,000 USDT
## 3. Important Notes
- Users engaging in fraudulent or abusive activities during the event will be disqualified from receiving rewards.
- Rewards will be reviewed and distributed within 3 business days after the event ends.
- Hibt reserves the final right of interpretation for this campaign.
